# Secret Bases

The same in both versions.

## Making your base

Go to [the tunnels](underground.md). Use the Explorer Kit from the Bag, choose DIGGER DRILL and face a wall (the tile and both tiles beside it must be solid, and not a Hideaway's hole). "Discovered a small cavern!" and the hole appears. Say yes to make your base there. Say no and the hole closes.

- **Moving:** use the Drill on another wall. It can be used again and again. Your placed goods go back to the PC, and the Big Boulders start over.
- **Going in:** walk into the hole. **Going out:** walk down off the bottom of the room.
- There are no other players' bases and no Radar.

## The PC

Use the PC at the top of the room: **DECORATE** (place, put away, move goods), **STORE GOODS**, **RECEIVE GOODS**, **CHECK FLAGS**, **EXIT**. It holds 200 goods, and your Bag holds 40 more. A placed good can wall you in, as in the original: Move Goods frees you. Press A on a TV, shelf or globe in your base: it tells you one of your records.

## Flags

Once you have a base, each new visit to a Hideaway earns a Flag. Register them at the PC with CHECK FLAGS. Your Flag rank decides how many goods you can place and how many Big Boulders must stay.

| Rank | Flags | Goods you can place | Big Boulders that must stay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Normal Flag | 0 | 10 | 16 |
| Bronze Flag | 1 | 12 | 15 |
| Silver Flag | 3 | 15 | 11 |
| Gold Flag | 10 | 15 | 6 |
| Platinum Flag | 50 | 15 | 0 |

### Traders in the tunnels

Eight traders stand in the tunnels. Each sells five goods a day, a new set at midnight, for money. Some goods are sold only after you're the Champion. Near: Eterna City, Flower Paradise, Newmoon Island, Route 209, Route 215, Route 216, Route 220 and Sunyshore City.

### Gifts

The Underground Man in Eterna City, for his missions:

| Mission | Reward |
|---|---|
| Make a Secret Base | Plain Table, Wooden Chair, Small Bookshelf and Buneary Doll |
| Decorate it | Turtwig Doll if you chose Turtwig, Chimchar Doll if Chimchar, Piplup Doll if Piplup |
| 1 Flag | Pretty Gem |
| 3 Flags | Shiny Gem |
| 10 Flags | Mystic Gem |
| 50 Flags | Glitter Gem |

In Hearthome City, Mr. Goods gives you the Gym Statue once you have all eight badges. His other goods can't be earned in 1.0 ([known issues](known-issues.md)).
